# Copilot Instructions (nampacx.github.io)

Personal developer blog "mikokono" (https://mikokono.de) by Michael Kokonowskyj. Built with Astro 7, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS 4, based on the AstroPaper theme. It is a static site deployed to GitHub Pages. There is no React and no MDX.

## Architecture

| Area       | Location                                      | Notes                                                                           |
| ---------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Content    | `src/data/blog/*.md`                          | Collection defined in `src/content.config.ts` (Zod schema, glob loader, `.md`)  |
| Pages      | `src/pages/`                                  | Index, posts (`[...page]`, `[...slug]`), tags, archives, search, about, RSS, OG |
| Layouts    | `src/layouts/`                                | `Layout.astro` (SEO, scripts), `PostDetails.astro`, `AboutLayout.astro`         |
| Components | `src/components/`                             | Plain `.astro` components only                                                  |
| Utils      | `src/utils/`                                  | Sorting, tags, paths, OG image generation (`satori` + `@resvg/resvg-js`)        |
| Settings   | `src/config.ts`, `src/constants.ts`           | Site metadata, feature flags, social links                                      |
| Styling    | `src/styles/global.css`, `typography.css`     | Tailwind 4 with CSS-variable theme tokens (`bg-background`, `text-foreground`)  |
| Search     | Pagefind                                      | Index is generated by `pnpm run build` into `public/pagefind` (git-ignored)     |
| Authoring  | `.github/skills/blog-creation/`               | Scripts for `blog:new`, `blog:validate` and `build`                             |

Markdown pipeline (`astro.config.ts`): `remark-toc` plus `remark-collapse` (collapses a `Table of contents` heading), Shiki themes `min-light` / `night-owl`.

## Commands

Use pnpm from the repository root.

- `pnpm install`
- `pnpm run dev` (http://localhost:4321)
- `pnpm run build` (runs `astro check`, `astro build` and Pagefind; use it before finishing a change)
- `pnpm run preview`
- `pnpm run lint`, `pnpm run format:check`, `pnpm run format`
- `pnpm run blog:new -- --title "..."` and `pnpm run blog:validate -- src/data/blog/<file>.md`

Pushing to `main` deploys via `.github/workflows/deploy-to-gh-pages.yml`.

## Blog posts

Follow `.github/instructions/content-md.instructions.md` for voice, structure and frontmatter, and `.github/skills/blog-creation/SKILL.md` for the workflow. Key rules:

- Posts live only in `src/data/blog/` as kebab-case `.md` files. The filename is the URL slug.
- Frontmatter is validated by `src/content.config.ts`. Required: `title`, `description`, `pubDatetime`. `author` defaults to the site author. Optional: `featured`, `draft`, `tags`, `ogImage`, `modDatetime`, `canonicalURL`.
- Images go under `src/assets/images/<folder>/` and are referenced relatively, for example `../../assets/images/<folder>/<image>.png`, with descriptive alt text. Do not leave unused images behind.
- Start the body with `## TL;DR`. Use `##` for top-level sections, since the layout renders the H1.
- Reuse the tag spelling and casing of existing posts.

## Coding conventions

- Import with the `@/` alias (maps to `src/`), for example `@/utils/getPath`, `@/config`.
- Keep the site static-first: no client frameworks, and only small inline scripts where unavoidable (see `src/scripts/theme.ts`).
- Style with Tailwind utilities and the theme tokens defined in `global.css`. Add new colors as tokens there instead of inlining hex values.
- Post sorting, filtering and tag logic belongs in `src/utils/`; extend it there rather than duplicating it in components.
- New OG image templates go under `src/utils/og-templates/`.
- New dependencies must be build-time friendly (no server runtime). Keep `pnpm-lock.yaml` as the only lockfile.

## Pitfalls

- Do not rename `src/content.config.ts` or change `BLOG_PATH` without updating the loader and the blog scripts.
- `postSlug` appears in some frontmatter but is not used by the routing; do not rely on it.
- If you change remark plugins in `astro.config.ts`, confirm the build passes and the collapsible TOC still works.
- Do not commit `dist/`, `.astro/`, `public/pagefind` or `.claude/`.

## Agent behavior

When asked to create or update a post, enforce the schema and file placement, then run `blog:validate`. When refactoring, keep logic in `src/utils/` and reuse existing tokens. Run `pnpm run build` and `pnpm run lint` before reporting a change as done, and say so if you could not.
